summary: Frontend-only testing of BookingWizard dual-layout: MOBILE single-scroll page (390x844) vs DESKTOP wizard (1280x900). All requirements verified: mobile shows no stepper/Continue/Back, all sections render on one page with coverage note, time is a Select dropdown with hourly slots 8AM-6PM and 'Pick a time' placeholder, van cards omit '/hr' price, mobile-confirm button is present + gated by allValid. Desktop retains stepper + wizard-next/back, no mobile-confirm, coverage note visible on Addresses step, no '/hr' text, time is a Select trigger. End-to-end mobile submission with existing customer (customer@example.com) succeeded — booking MWVA8627E80 created and navigated to /jobs.
critical_code_review_comments: BookingWizard.jsx is 430 lines — consider splitting Section/AccessPicker/AuthModal into separate files as the component grows.

isMobile matchMedia listener re-renders whole form on breakpoint change but preserves state via same `form` object — good; however key on motion.div changes between 'all' and step index which causes AnimatePresence exit/enter on resize.
photos are uploaded sequentially inside submitBooking; consider Promise.all for parallelism.
seed_data_creation: Created 1 real booking MWVA8627E80 (SW1A 1AA -> E16 2FR, Small Van, 2026-10-02 11:00) via mobile flow.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Mobile viewport is 390x844 (<640px triggers isMobile). Desktop viewport 1280x900. When clicking address autocomplete options in mobile without scroll_into_view, coords can hit BottomNav; use element.scroll_into_view_if_needed() + non-forced click for autocomplete options. Time uses shadcn Select with data-testid on trigger; options selectable via get_by_role('option', name='11:00 AM').
